notes: Distinguished codified party-led planned socialism from Lenin’s NEP period, Trotsky’s exile critique and Titoist market self-management. Formal councils and national self-determination coexist with restricted pluralism. Family and sexual policy vary substantively; neutral responses record that conflict, not missing evidence. Checked all 240 literal statements and agreement directions, the 15 independent axis briefs, counter-evidence, source references, period, metadata and inferred uncertainty. All 240 responses remain conservatively marked inferred; exact IDs are in the separate review. Technical validation cannot certify the historical or political estimates. Similarity decisions are added only after checking calculated neighbours. Neutral-density warnings reviewed: each neutral question’s mechanism combines specified competing objectives; see its rationale and separate review. No neutral was added as a default for missing evidence.

axes.evidence: The communist party’s leading role limits pluralist competition while councils and universal socialist participation retain formal importance.
axes.counterEvidence: Party accountability is not identical to personal dictatorship; competitive multiparty alternation remains restricted.

axes.evidence: Protecting socialist power and organised public welfare favours state control over opposition and private activity.
axes.counterEvidence: Internal criticism and socialist legality can constrain arbitrariness; exact modern digital and vaccine mechanisms are contextual estimates.

axes.evidence: Equality of nationalities and socialist common institutions support recognised cultural pluralism.
axes.counterEvidence: Historical assimilation and dominant-language practice qualify ideal equality; separate traditions do not always override socialist unity.

axes.evidence: International worker solidarity coexists with controlled borders and state economic allocation.
axes.counterEvidence: Not all adherents favour closed borders; refugee and family admission remain possible within a managed transition.

axes.evidence: Armed defence of socialism and support for revolutionary allies coexist with anti-imperialist peace claims.
axes.counterEvidence: Peaceful coexistence and negotiated restraint vary by period; military force is not doctrinally rejected at all costs.

axes.evidence: Socialist international solidarity coexists with national state power and independent development.
axes.counterEvidence: Binding authority of socialist alliances differs from unrestricted obedience to capitalist international institutions.

axes.evidence: Public industry and collective agriculture replace the commanding power of private capital.
axes.counterEvidence: Personal property, small production and commodity exchange can persist; social ownership does not erase every transaction.

axes.evidence: State control of external exchange protects planned industrialisation and socialist productive assets.
axes.counterEvidence: Mutually beneficial foreign trade is retained; protection is not an absolute ban on every imported commodity.

axes.evidence: Compulsory planning allocates investment, production and essential prices to collective priorities.
axes.counterEvidence: Commodity money and labour incentives persist within planning, so contractual wage negotiation is possible in a bounded form.

axes.evidence: Class power and major wealth concentrations should be abolished with broad material security.
axes.counterEvidence: Wage differentials persist; compensating large landowners is less aligned than expropriation despite the shared distributive goal.

axes.evidence: Materialist civil institutions govern law independently of clerical authority.
axes.counterEvidence: Private worship and pragmatic accommodation occur in some variants; personal faith differs from an official religious source of law.

axes.evidence: Women’s work and education support emancipation alongside frequently retained family and sexual conventions.
axes.counterEvidence: Orthodox regimes differed on homosexuality, abortion and inherited customs; social reform and conservative family policy substantively compete.

axes.evidence: Scientific productive development and industrial infrastructure are central to the socialist programme.
axes.counterEvidence: Materialism is not an endorsement of every risky enhancement; medical and irreversible ecosystem mechanisms are explicit analogies.

axes.evidence: Democratic centralism and national planning coordinate local institutions while formal national self-determination is recognised.
axes.counterEvidence: Federal constitutions and local soviets qualify administrative uniformity; practical secession limits differ from its doctrinal recognition.

axes.evidence: Historical materialism emphasises class relations, education and social production over fixed racial destiny.
axes.counterEvidence: Individual physiology and temperament are not denied; modern trait-weight claims are uncertain contextual estimates.
